analysed.notes: The yes rests on the rubric's class rule. This zip is the CTAN release of the published class moderncv, so the 847-line moderncv.cls, the style files and the bundled tweaklist.sty count as published (W1), not as bespoke code. template.tex loads the class unchanged. Its only own definitions are one documented hook value (bibliographyitemlabel, template.tex:121) and the ifxetexorluatex font branch (template.tex:32-50), and both are reducible. The class draws TikZ artwork inside itself: gradient banner, circular photo, vertical timeline, skill shapes. This is not raised as ART, because it is chosen by style and option values of the published class, like the rubric's tikzposter example. If class.moderncv were not accepted as one way, the verdict would flip to no (BESPOKE and ART). The class is incompatible with biblatex/biber and with babel Spanish (KNOWN_BUGS:1-3), so the bibliography way is limited to bib.bibtex-bst. The zip ships v2.6.1, which may be newer than the TeX distribution's copy, so ship its files. manual/moderncv_userguide.tex was only grepped for its preamble; it is documentation, not the template. Nothing was compiled.

analysed.notes: thesis.cls (86 lines) is class.article[11pt,titlepage] plus the lix.sty meta-package (1149 lines); both read in full. Every lix command is a bundle of published packages or a thin alias, and the only conditionals test whether a field was given, so they flatten per document. The kernel-internal edits (seccntformat redefinition via addheadingseparator, AddToHook cmd/section/before clearpage) reduce to a titlesec label and pg.break. Judgment calls: tabularray mapped to tbl.nicematrix (row already holds tabu), esint mapped to math.amssymb, silence and numspell treated as non-ways (non-visual, content). svg/Inkscape branch of fig is the main risk of a stricter reader calling EXTERNAL; titlespacing numberless is unconfirmed against the titlesec manual. Dead lix options for this class: cover, header, isbn, periodical, sign, ornaments, stdclass. No text addressed to an AI was found in the zip.
